Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (0) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Superseded holds can still permit merges ✓ Resolved

Resolving commit: 12fde38

>
>Resolution reason >
> >
>Added newest_hold(pr) and a check in check_sensitive so that a reason-5 decision only allows a merge
>when it answers the PR's newest MERGE-HOLD; older holds' decisions are refused with a "not the
>newest hold" message, even when only review records changed. Docs and tests were updated to match.
>
>
>
>Description >
> >
>check_sensitive accepts a trusted decision after a matching hold without checking whether that
>decision says the hold was superseded, despite the new instruction to post clearing decisions that
>allow nothing. If a newer hold follows only review-record changes, the older hold still passes the
>head check, so supplying its clearing decision to gate or merge --allow-hold 5 permits the
>merge.
>
>
Context sources
✅ Context preparation
  Commit messages: summarized; full text retained for this review
Review mode: Auto: ⚖️ Balanced: Sensitive merge authorization logic warrants a careful single-pass review.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
